meta.title: Tomoyo Design | Try an effect. Get the prompt.
meta.description: Try UI effects in your browser, then copy a prompt to build them in your project with AI.

preview.guidance: The prompt changes with the effect you choose.
preview.imageAlt: A blue and cream print of a quiet rocky coastline
heading: Sit by
the sea.
preview.body: Find a patch of shade and watch the light on the water. Everything else can wait a few minutes.
headline: Try an effect.
Get the prompt.

hover-lift.name: Hover lift
hover-lift.summary: Using your existing stack, lift the card {distance}px on hover and return smoothly.
hover-lift.hint: Hover, focus, or tap the card.

soft-reveal.name: Soft reveal
soft-reveal.summary: Fade the card in and move it up {distance}px over {duration}ms, then let it rest.
soft-reveal.hint: Tap the card or replay the entrance.

frosted-glass.name: Frosted glass
frosted-glass.summary: Use a translucent surface with {blur}px backdrop blur. Keep the text crisp.
frosted-glass.hint: Replay to see the surface become glass.

prompt.label: Copy this prompt
prompt.intro: Copy this description into your AI tool alongside the component you want to change.
prompt.error: Your browser could not copy the prompt. The text is selected below; copy it using your keyboard or device menu.
prompt.reduced: Reduced motion is on. Previews stay still; every prompt includes the same option.

showcase.title: Small details. A different feeling.
showcase.intro: Hover to try. Open one to tune it to your project.

heading: Use this effect
in your project.
guide.intro: Each preview has a prompt with the behavior and timing written out. Copy it into the AI tool you already use.

steps.title: Try a preview
steps.body: Pick an effect, then hover, focus, or tap the card. Use Replay if you want another look.

steps.title: Copy its prompt
steps.body: The full prompt includes timing, interaction and accessibility details. You can read it before copying.

steps.title: Give it to your AI
steps.body: Paste the prompt alongside the component you want to change. It asks the AI to keep your content and design, then apply the effect.
